title: US government snitch-finder pleads guilty to leaking state secrets to foreign spies
content_md: Connor Jones reports: The former Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) IT specialist previously accused of trying to pass secret and top-secret information to foreign spies has pleaded guilty following a successful FBI sting.
